rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone adds to income or resources that are not quite enough.

example.english: Ming uses food delivery to eke out his full-time income.
example.traditional: 阿明靠送外賣幫補正職收入。
example.jyutping: aa3 ming4 kaau3 sung3 ngoi6 maai6 bong1 bou2 zing3 zik1 sau1 jap6

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase when someone struggles to make a living or get by through effort.

example.english: Keung came to Hong Kong alone and had to eke out a living by working several temporary jobs.
example.traditional: 阿強一個人嚟到香港，靠做幾份散工捱世界。
example.jyutping: aa3 koeng4 jat1 go3 jan4 lai4 dou3 hoeng1 gong2 kaau3 zou6 gei2 fan6 saan2 gung1 ngaai4 sai3 gaai3
